prepare_acceptance.packs: A packs + empty_after_cuts files == 578; B packs + (empty files x their fold roles) == 1724; every empty_after_cuts file listed in the verification
prepare_acceptance.scalers: scalers.fold_k.files == sorted training contents of fold k (285 / 291 / 290), disjoint from that fold's validation and test; n_samples_seen > 0 on both sides

prepare_acceptance.access_retries: listed in the verification, whatever their number

prepare_acceptance.any_failure: stop and report to the user; the training array is not submitted

prepare_failure_policy: No automatic retry. The pre-approved retry (D3) was worded for training tasks; a failed prepare is reported to the user, who decides.

prepare_estimates.wall: <= 55 min (observation <= 28 min, packs <= 12 min, scalers <= 5 min, publish <= 10 min; scaled from smoke phase_seconds 45.5/0.18/9.7 s for 6 files with 4 workers to 578 files with 8 workers); limit 2 h
prepare_estimates.node_local_disk_peak: ~17 GB (packs 6.8 + inputs.tar 6.8 + observations 1.8 + audit tensors <= 1.8); job 4437449 held ~31 GB on cn-030 (type_d); ENOSPC would cost <= 1 CPU-hour; risk accepted

train_time_calibration: Per-fold projection from real event counts (1.334 graphs/event in the smoke files): 3.24 / 3.27 / 3.29 h; 1.5 x T + 0.5 h = 5.35 / 5.40 / 5.43 h -> --time 05:30:00. The smoke's throughput loop has no per-batch sync; its own 2-epoch fit took 3.05x the rate estimate, but native student_sage 4424084 runs (30 epochs) took 1.13-1.31x the rate prediction, so the excess is a fixed per-epoch cost. At 1.3x a task takes ~4.2 h < 5.5 h. SMASH and DCM graph sizes may differ; the 600 s load allowance is not measured.

train_failure_policy.infrastructure (NODE_FAIL; EACCES after: one pre-approved retry per task (D3): cd /home/vbocharnikov/hgnd_experiments/smash_train_20261028_4f82efeae9_submission && env -u SMASH_DCM_PREPARED -u SMASH_NATIVE sbatch --parsable --array=<t> --time=05:30:00 --exclude=cn-007,cn-008,cn-034,<failed node> --export=ALL,<same variables>,SMASH_RESUME_MIRROR=/scratch/vbocharnikov/hgnd/experiments/smash_train_20261028/mirror/task_<t>_<A>_<t> /home/vbocharnikov/hgnd_experiments/smash_train_20261028_4f82efeae9/slurm/smash_train.hpc.sbatch ; pass SMASH_RESUME_MIRROR only if its state.json exists, otherwise restart from scratch; the evaluation train index names the retry's receipt
train_failure_policy.not infrastructure (TIMEOUT, OOM, non-fi: reported to the user, no retry
train_failure_policy.hash or guard failure: stops the stage: scancel the pending array tasks and report

known_gaps: Resume path only: smash_train.py sha(mirror/state.json) and the read of effective_config.json from the resume mirror are not wrapped in the EACCES retry; changing them would change the code digest and require a new smoke. An EACCES there goes to the user.
submission_hygiene: Submit with env -u SMASH_RESUME_MIRROR -u SMASH_DCM_PREPARED -u SMASH_NATIVE so login-shell variables cannot leak through --export=ALL.
first_wave_watch: Tasks 0-2 must print 'Training seed ... from epoch 0: ~1.18M train / ~0.40M validation graphs' within ~15 min; an earlier failure -> scancel the array and report (cost <= 0.3 GPU-h). The smoke used from_directory; from_bundle/fetch is covered only by the CPU test.
before_each_evaluate: Manual stop-rule check: e_cls == 0 in two or more seeds sends the census back for checking; a head minimum at epoch 29 flags the run as budget-limited (no extension); written into the evaluation launch entry before submission.
budget: training 30-38 GPU-h (3.3-4.2 h x 9), with three evaluations 31-41 GPU-h against the protocol's 30-37; prepare <= 8 CPU-h
